AWAGAM

Official repository for the AWAGAM TLD and domain blocker, published by Jens Oliver Meiert (IA Defensa). Builds are signed with the same key as the direct downloads, so installations from either source update interchangeably.

Currently it serves 1 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://iadefensa.github.io/awagam-android/fdroid/repo

If you would like to manually verify the fingerprint (SHA-256) of the repository signing key, here it is:
